| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** `output` | Lines over the edges | Lines over the edges, Accumulator, Table of lines | The found lines in white over the edges in gray, the accumulator of votes, or a table of the lines. |
| **Edge smoothing** `sigma` | 1 | 0.5 to 5 px | The sigma of the Gaussian blur before Canny finds edges. scikit-image uses 1. |
| **Low threshold** `lowThreshold` | 0.1 | 0 to 2 | Weak edges must reach this Sobel magnitude, on the luma from 0 to 1. scikit-image uses 0.1. |
| **High threshold** `highThreshold` | 0.2 | 0 to 2 | Strong edges must reach this Sobel magnitude. scikit-image uses 0.2. A value below the low threshold counts as the low threshold. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Angles** `angles` | 180 | 30 to 720 | The number of angles over half a turn. scikit-image uses 180, one per degree. |
| **Vote threshold** `threshold` | 0.5 | 0.05 to 1 | A line needs at least this share of the votes of the strongest line. scikit-image uses 0.5. |
| **Most lines** `lines` | 10 | 1 to 100 | At most this many lines, the strongest first. |
| **Distance apart** `minDistance` | 9 | 1 to 100 px | Two lines must be at least this far apart in distance from the origin, or far enough apart in angle. scikit-image uses 9. |
| **Angle apart** `minAngle` | 10 | 1 to 90 | Two lines must be at least this many angle steps apart, or far enough apart in distance. With 180 angles, a step is 1 degree. scikit-image uses 10. |
